question: Can memory of factorized causal relationships use a paid diagnostic intervention to recover a previously learned dynamics regime and transfer to an unfamiliar recombination, beating independently trained conventional controls with matched information and action budgets?
hypothesis: In a fresh integer-valued nonstationary intervention environment, the bounded causal-module learner will achieve lower actual goal-action regret on both cold-return-A and never-trained compositional-C audits than the strongest of forgetting-RLS and a fully trained deterministic integer recurrent predictor, while preserving unrelated learned relationships, performing no evaluator-label training, and keeping bounded CPU and model state.

predecessor_evidence.note: Historical CR16 results are negative; no reused first-use seeds, environment or post-result tuning.

inputs.name: procedural integer causal-world identity manifest
inputs.source: Fresh self-created deterministic synthetic four-regime integer causal interventions; world seeds 410001..410016; no CR16/SL15 original data and no private data.

frozen_design.split: 16 disjoint worlds. Fresh three-channel state and six signed interventions. A has 64 paid observations; B replaces one parent relation for 64; held-out cold return-A audit immediately after B, before A is retrained; then 32 paid A observations; never-trained C recombines one A row, one B row, and one novel causal row, followed by cold C audit. C regime outcomes never train during this frozen first-use.
frozen_design.ordering: Five learners receive the identical 160-step physical training state/action/next-state trace. 16 paid goal episodes per arm at each of two marks (128 and 160); every episode consists of one fixed, charged diagnostic intervention with its observed consequence, then one separately charged learner-selected goal action. The diagnostic consequence is supplied equally to every arm for selection but is not used for training. Evaluator-only counterfactuals compute regret and never enter learner observations. Cold snapshots/restore after steps 64,128,160.
frozen_design.action_and_data_budget: 16 worlds x 5 arms x 160 independent charged training transitions = 12800; 16 worlds x 5 arms x 2 audits x 16 episodes x 2 charged actions = 5120; total 17920 independently charged actions; no private additional data.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 stdlib CPU only, one original prospective evaluation on Ubuntu and Windows; no paid API or GPU. Integer-only environmental dynamics and integer recurrent baseline for cross-platform reproducible checkpoint bytes. All arms receive the same training trace, diagnostic states and consequences; model capacities and number of trainable weight updates reported.
frozen_design.capacity: Candidate and random-route control: at most three causal modules per output of 3 channels. No-archive: one per output. Forgetting-RLS: one fully trainable conventional state/action regression per output. Recurrent: eight hidden cells with trained input, recurrent, hidden bias, output and output bias matrices; deterministic integer fixed-point updates. 64KiB maximum per checkpoint across all arms.
frozen_design.evaluator: Primary is actual squared target-distance regret after learner-selected physically charged goal action minus the best of all six evaluator-only candidate actions. Evaluate 16 disjoint states/targets after one charged diagnostic intervention per episode. No learner receives evaluator-only loss, optimal-action labels, regime labels, source equation or counterfactual outcomes. Return-A and never-trained-C evaluated before any learning in those audit episodes.
frozen_design.portability: All serialized non-timing fields, all cold checkpoint hashes, per-action predictions and selected actions must agree byte-for-byte across Ubuntu and Windows; wall-clock timing excluded only from equality comparison.
frozen_design.first_use: Preregistration-only commit must be an ancestor of candidate implementation and first original study. Only a frozen candidate SHA may execute original registered seed identities. Toy/negative controls must use non-registered seed identities.
frozen_design.constraints: Research contribution only, not native Yggdrasil integration or accepted research. Dataset/evaluator code cannot expose hidden regime labels to learners.

controls.name: no_archive
controls.description: Identical causal regression/update/diagnostic information, but no stored prior causal modules.

controls.name: random_route
controls.description: Same candidate model, capacity, data, and paid intervention information; deterministic sham route or replacement instead of evidential selection.

controls.name: forgetting_rls
controls.description: Fully trainable conventional recency-weighted recursive least squares on the identical 160-step trace, with the same diagnostic observation before decision.

controls.name: integer_recurrent
controls.description: Eight-cell fully trainable recurrent model with integer fixed-point input/recurrent/readout/bias weights, exposed recurrent state and identical trace; deterministic byte-identical cross-OS checkpoints.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY iff all 16 worlds and 17920 charges are complete, source/input hashes match, no evaluator leakage, both audit phases candidate mean regret at least 0.005 below min(forgetting_rls, integer_recurrent), also at least 0.005 below no_archive and random_route; candidate wins over both conventional controls in at least 12 of 16 worlds on each phase; cold return-A structural recovery in >=12/16, correct unseen-C factorized reuse in >=12/16, false module routes <=2/16 unseen-C, cross-OS non-timing and checkpoint parity 100%, checkpoint <=65536 bytes; per-OS median candidate CPU <=2.5x forgetting_rls and <=2.0x no_archive. Even success is DEV signal pending independent validation.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV when protocol/custody valid but primary false and candidate achieves a positive regret gain vs at least one control on at least one phase or reproducible correct structural reuse in >=1 world.
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV when protocol/custody valid but all support gates fail and no qualifying partial signal is observed.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE only for violated prereg/data identities, changed first-use seed budget, source drift, missing fully trained baseline, cross-platform non-timing/checkpoint inequality, loss leakage, broken cold restore, unsigned/garbled receipts or uncharged environmental actions; performance failure alone is NOT infrastructure failure.

prohibited_after_primary_run: repeat of original first-use on tuned source
preregistration_note: This file is the preregistration-only first commit, before implementation and before any registered outcome. The synthetic successor remains external DEV research; no native model or loop authority.
